mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO group_batch_task_item ( tenant_id, task_id, group_link_id, group_jid, account_id, status, error_code, description, operated_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES
(#{row.tenantId}, #{row.taskId}, #{row.groupLinkId}, #{row.groupJid}, #{row.accountId}, #{row.status}, #{row.errorCode}, #{row.description}, #{row.operatedAt}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM group_batch_task_item WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT item.group_link_id AS groupLinkId, item.group_jid AS groupJid, acc.ws_phone AS accountPhone, item.status AS status, item.description AS description, item.operated_at AS operatedAt FROM group_batch_task_item item LEFT JOIN account acc ON acc.tenant_id = item.tenant_id AND acc.id = item.account_id AND acc.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE item.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY item.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE group_batch_task_item SET status = #{waitingStatus}, group_jid = #{row.groupJid}, account_id = #{row.accountId}, current_command_id = #{row.currentCommandId}, attempt_count = #{row.attemptCount}, candidate_cursor = #{row.candidateCursor}, result_deadline_at = #{row.resultDeadlineAt}, error_code = NULL, description = '等待协议端返回群快照', updated_at = #{row.updatedAt} WHERE id = #{row.id} AND tenant_id = #{row.tenantId} AND status = #{pendingStatus} AND current_command_id IS NULL

UPDATE group_batch_task_item SET completed_scope_mask = CASE WHEN MOD(FLOOR(completed_scope_mask / #{scopeMask}), 2) = 1 THEN completed_scope_mask ELSE completed_scope_mask + #{scopeMask} END, updated_at = GREATEST(updated_at, #{observedAt}) WHERE current_command_id = #{commandId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM group_batch_task_item WHERE current_command_id = #{commandId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update:
UPDATE group_batch_task_item SET status = #{canceledStatus}, current_command_id = NULL, result_deadline_at = NULL, operated_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
AND status IN (#{pendingStatus}, #{waitingStatus})
